sources.title: surafelasfawosen/chatbot-using-BART-model-s - GitHub
sources.snippet: This project is an Intent-based Chatbot that understands user intentions and generates intelligent, context-aware responses. It leverages the powerful BART model (a state-of-the-art sequence-to-sequence transformer) fine-tuned for conversational AI tasks. The chatbot is deployed with a user-friendly interface using Gradio, making it easy to interact with and test in real-time.
